Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1148
Claimant:
Jennifer Tyler
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
15 Jun 2023
The claim was reported by the insured's representing attorney after a low-speed head-on collision, and the adjuster
opened a file and requested the police report and initial photographs.
15 Jul 2023
The police report confirms the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of the collision, and the driver is named on the
policy in force on the loss date.
22 Sep 2023
Scene photographs show the front-end damage and confirm several details of the impact, but no independent
witnesses have come forward to describe how the collision happened.
1 Oct 2023
Reviewing the vehicle file, no prior damage to the vehicle is known, and nothing in the records suggests the damage
occurred before the coverage period began.
2 Oct 2023
The claimant reports neck and back strain and has described the same account in every conversation so far, with the
injury pattern appearing consistent with the kind and force of this crash.
3 Nov 2023
The claimant's medical records show no earlier injury to the same body area, and the treatment so far has followed a
usual course that has tapered off as the claimant improved.
24 Nov 2023
Repair estimates have been reviewed, but it is not yet clear whether all of the listed damage came from this impact,
so the appraiser has been asked to isnpect the vehicle again.
3 Dec 2023
Counsel for the claimant confirmed by letter that the claimant will provide the treatment records and wage information
requested in the earlier correspondence.
6 Dec 2023
The adjuster spoke with the treating provider's office, which confirmed the visit dates and the course of care, and
noted that the claimant's account of symptoms has stayed consistent across each visit.
13 Dec 2023
Pending receipt of the appraiser's supplemental report, the adjuster is reviewing whether the damage listing needs to
be separated by cause before any settlement offer is made.
3 Feb 2024
The file remains open while the supplemental appraisal and outstanding records are collected, and the adjuster will
update the reserve once those items are received.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
